purpose: Pipeline scripts: sync data to xlsx, generate/upload images, generate videos, fix data issues
data_flow: JSON source of truth → sync_json_to_xlsx.py → xlsx upload files → Yandex Market
image_flow: generate_cards.py → push_main_cards.py → convert_to_png_and_upload.py → YC Storage S3

sync_json_to_xlsx.py.intent: Copy all edits from JSON source of truth into the base xlsx upload file (2.xlsx → 2_updated.xlsx). Updates: title, images, description, brand, tags, all characteristics. Does NOT touch: prices, Market errors, quality score, archive status.
sync_json_to_xlsx.py.notes: JSON headers are in row index 3 (row 4), data starts at index 7 (row 8). Matches columns by header name (strips * and whitespace). Skips SKIP_HEADERS set.

upload_images_to_yc.py.intent: Upload all images from yamarcket-images/ sibling repo to Yandex Cloud Object Storage. Skips already-uploaded files. Uploads main_cards/, instructions_v2/, games/ directories.
upload_images_to_yc.py.outputs: Files in S3 bucket yamarcket with ACL public-read
upload_images_to_yc.py.notes: Uses head_object to skip already-uploaded files. Content-type set automatically (image/jpeg or image/png).

push_main_cards.py.intent: 1) Convert PNG from output/main_cards/{brand}/ to JPEG in yamarcket-images/main_cards/{brand}/. 2) Delete old flat (non-brand-subdir) JPEG files. 3) Update JSON: replace first image URL per SKU with new raw GitHub URL.
push_main_cards.py.notes: JPEG quality=87. Raw GitHub URL format: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anton-ai5010/yamarcket-images/main/main_cards/{brand}/{SKU}_{country}.jpg. SKU extracted from filename by regex GFT\d+.

convert_to_png_and_upload.py.intent: 1) Copy original PNGs from pipeline/output/main_cards/ (or convert from JPG if no original). 2) Upload PNG to YC Storage. 3) Delete old JPG from S3 and local. 4) Update JSON: .jpg → .png in all image URLs.
convert_to_png_and_upload.py.notes: Also processes instructions_v2/ and games/ directories. Run AFTER push_main_cards.py.

generate_card_variants.py.intent: Generate 50 pixel-shifted variants of 4 universal cards (email/delivery/feedback/support). Upload to YC Storage universal/. Update JSON: assign variant N to product N (cycling through 0-49). Run sync_json_to_xlsx.py at end.
generate_card_variants.py.notes: Shift grid: 10 steps x (-4..+5) × 5 steps y (-2..+2) = 50 variants. Bottom 220px (logo area) is shifted. Avoids Yandex duplicate image detection.

make_card_video_pro.py.intent: Professional 30-second promo video for a product card. 5 scenes: appear → float+3D rock → features → 360° rotation → CTA. Renders 900 frames at 1080×1440, assembles MP4.
make_card_video_pro.py.notes: Prototype for GFT164 PlayStation $10 USA. To mass-generate: parametrize CARD_PATH, OUT, and text constants (service name, denomination). Codec: libx264, bitrate 8000k, no audio.

make_card_video.py.intent: Earlier/simpler video generation script (superseded by make_card_video_pro.py).

update_instructions.py.intent: Mass update of activation instructions in product descriptions. Replaces generic instructions with brand-specific multi-method HTML instructions for: steam_game, steam_wallet, xbox, playstation, apple, google_play, nintendo, roblox, spotify, amazon, razer, battlenet, epic, ea, mobile_voucher, paysafe, riot, netflix, etc.
update_instructions.py.notes: Contains INSTRUCTIONS dict with HTML strings per service. Matches by brand/service name logic. Preserves existing intro paragraphs, only replaces activation section.

regenerate_email_card.py.intent: Regenerate email_example_card.png without Yandex Market logo. Shows styled envelope with activation code placeholder. Uses FiraSans fonts, gradient background (blue tones).

fix_10_exceptions.py.intent: Generate instruction images and update descriptions/URLs for 10 SKUs with generic instructions: Disney (6), Weyyak (1), Division 2 DLC/Ubisoft (1), Fallout 76 (1), ESO Xbox (1).
outputs: Custom PNG instruction images in instructions_v2/
fix_10_exceptions.py.notes: Renders at 2160×2880 (scale factor S=1.25), saves to both local output and yamarcket-images/instructions_v2/

fix_short_descriptions.py.intent: Generate full descriptions for 163 SKUs that had only activation instructions (<500 chars). Adds: intro paragraph, benefits list, activation steps (from existing), important notes. Service-specific content for: roblox, steam, xbox, playstation, apple, google_play, nintendo, spotify, amazon, and mobile vouchers.

update_image_urls_to_yc.py.intent: Update image URLs in JSON from GitHub raw URLs to Yandex Cloud Storage URLs.
update_image_urls_to_yc.py.outputs: Updated JSON with YC Storage URLs

legacy_scripts.prepare.py: Convert xlsx to jsonl (old pipeline, now replaced by direct JSON editing)
legacy_scripts.finalize.py: Convert jsonl to xlsx (replaced by sync_json_to_xlsx.py)
legacy_scripts.generate_progress.py: Create progress.json for Ralph Loop queue (old pipeline)
legacy_scripts.write_result.py: Safe write interface for Claude to update jsonl (old pipeline)
